notes.title: Price cut and major announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

It's been a while since I last updated Operation Marakudja, and I'd like to explain why. First of all, I've decided to lower the price of the game from $11.99 to $3.99. The main reason is that I find the game far too cumbersome to manage. As a solo developer, this represents a considerable challenge.

In parallel, I had created another game, Don't Fall, in which you control a frog who has to reach the top of the map to find out why all the objects are floating. This game, developed in a month, received more downloads than Operation Marakudja, which took me four months of intense effort. I was disappointed by this result.

Right now, I'm devoting my days and evenings to a new game that will be released soon. However, this doesn't mean that Operation Marakudja has been abandoned. I'd like to resume its development with an entirely new and unique concept, rather than simply copying an existing FPS. This process will take time.

As for the game being free, for the time being I'm leaving it at $3.99. I'd rather not take the risk of making it free immediately, as Steam offers new visibility to games that go Free To Play. I'll keep you posted on further developments.

Thanks to everyone who has played my game and for your continued support.

notes.title: Operation Marakudja becomes Free to Play!
notes.content:
Dear players,

I've received many messages indicating that Operation Marakudja would benefit from being a Free to Play game, attracting more players through microtransactions. After careful consideration, you're right! It's time to transform Operation Marakudja to offer an even more accessible and captivating experience.

I'm determined to rethink the game from A to Z - this includes graphics, gameplay, music, and even the difficulty curve, to bring you an unparalleled gaming experience. This big change is a challenge I'm ready to take on to make Operation Marakudja better than ever.

To support this transition, I invite you to buy the game now and share your feedback. Your support is crucial during this development phase. And remember, Steam offers a refund policy if you're not satisfied with the game, with no pressure from me.

Give me a few months to polish Operation Marakudja. I promise to keep you informed of progress every month, so don't miss my next announcements. Share and add the game to your wishlist - with your help, we can make Operation Marakudja a memorable and successful game.

Together, let's make Operation Marakudja an exceptional experience for everyone!

Thank you for your continued support,

Hunt Games.

notes.title: Official launch of Operation Marakudja
notes.content:
I'm delighted to announce that Operation Marakudja is finally here! Available now on Steam, my multiplayer game invites you to fight in dynamic arenas where strategy and speed are the keys to success. With three unique game modes, randomly generated maps and a variety of weapons and characters, every session is guaranteed to deliver a new and exciting experience.

As soon as Operation Marakudja launches, I'll be playing with you! Take part in intense battles, team up with your friends or take them on, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate champion.

Don't wait any longer, add Operation Marakudja to your wishlist and start your adventure. Thank you to all our players and fans for your support during development. I look forward to seeing you in-game and continuing to improve and expand this universe together.
